reviews.t: Easy to use and good product
reviews.x: I used these as dipping powders. They are finely milled enough to use as dip powders. I swatched them all today and was very happy with the coverage and colors. I love the variety of colors (especially the clear) and how it has a wide opening to the jar so it's easy to dip my finger in and tap off excess without making a mess.

Like many others I was forced to start doing my own nails since the pandemic started.  After countless hours of YouTube tutorials I decided to give it a whirl and  purchased this Vafee acrylic powder. I must say I love it!  I use it as a dip system instead because I'm not good enough/fast enough yet at applying it with a brush before it hardens. This method was super easy for me as a beginner and the coverage was great! The colors are beautiful! The size of the jars were good for the price. Defi

I was skeptical about the product at first as I’ve tried so many different acrylics but my first impression when I started doing my nails I was very impressed with the quality of the acrylic I did my nails on the 1st of this month && my nails are still going strong! I will definitely be ordering more from this seller && I highly recommend this product! It’s really good for beginners especially as it’s easy to use && set at a good price!

Probably like everyone during this time wanted to try my hand at doing my own nails, loved that it included four colors and 1 oz jars. I used with acrylic liquid and as a beginner I must say my nails turned out pretty good. The powders arrived neatly packaged together. I even got a little fancy and did two colors on one nails...lol..

Yes! After everything closed due to COVID-19 I had to look for ways to do my nails at home . I ordered this set and it’s awesome! Really good quality and it can be used as dio powder too. The colors are spot on as the picture and they can be used alone or you can use nail polish on top if you like. I specially use the white when I want to use neon or bright nail polish and they stand out. Perfect for summer nails.

First time applying color acrylic, definitely a little harder then regular acrylic only because its color so if it’s applied incorrectly you will see the color around the cuticle. When monomer touches brush with color acrylic it does not form the same bead  regular acrylic does which makes it harder to apply. Other then that I like it and will continue to use, just clean your brush a lot and cuticles.

reviews.t: Good for dip method as well!
reviews.x: This product is exceptional for beginner users. I think I’m a nail technician now. The containers are smaller than expected, but the size is stated on the product description. Honestly; unless you’re an actual nail tech you may not need bigger containers anyway. I use them as a dip powder instead of an acrylic and it’s a nail hack that has saved my quarantine beauty regimen!

Got this set so I could fill in my nails at home due to covid restrictions on salons in my city. Excellent product, easy to use, did a great job. Also comes in 4 colors so it’s very versatile in creating different looks. 10/10 would recommend, especially due to the great price!
The white was very hard to work with it kept getting stuck to my brush and it was hard to manage , dried up quick. But overall if you’re a beginner I highly recommend it!

reviews.t: Very fine easy to use powder
reviews.x: I use it for dip Nails and it work beautifully!!!

reviews.t: The way the powder doesn't dry too fast before full application. Luv it!!
reviews.x: For starters, I don't dislike anything about this product. But what I like about this product is that it goes on smoothly and doesn't dry out like some other acrylic powders. I actually use the Vafee Acrylic Powder set for nail tips and doing my own nails. No, I am not a nail tech, but I love doing my own nails and it saves me money. I am starting to do my own nails due to the pandemic. To be clear i use this product for dip nails not acrylic with monomer. I ordered this product and i wasnt dissapointed. You get a lot of product for the price and the jar is big enough to dip your finger in if you dont use long tips. The only thing i would have to complain about is the powder is not very fine so if you dont do the application correctly it will look like you have grains of sand on your nails, which gives it a cool look to be h

This acrylic powder is an amazing product. When I first used it I thought it was going to have a bad constituency or dry up fast. I was wrong it gives you enough time to apply it and looks amazing afterwords. I have done many sets with this acrylic powder and had no problems with it. I will for sure be buying it in the future and recommend it to any body looking for good acrylic powder for a good price.

I love this acrylic powder! I am a first-time user of acrylic powder for doing my nails, and this product is easy to use, comes in four different colors, and the price is right! I love how my nails turned out! The colors are high in pigment, and I love the colors! It also cured nicely and is strong enough that my nails didn't break. I would definitely recommend this product!

I love this acrylic powder! I love the colors! It's great acrylic and works very well and definitely would recommend for people who have handled acrylic before. i wouldn't recommend this for people who haven't worked with acrylic before as it dries faster then some acrylic and could be difficult for beginners. Above all love this product and definitely would buy again!

I love this acrylic powder! I love the colors! It's great acrylic and works very well and definitely would recommend for people who have handled acrylic before. i wouldn't recommend this for people who haven't worked with acrylic before as it dries faster then some acrylic and could be difficult for beginners. Above all love this product and definitely would buy again!

I ordered this set because I wanted to try to do dip nails with a gel base, so I only needed the acrylic. The set comes with 4 colors, the pink and gray are pale, but I like pastels so it was right up my alley. I watched a YouTube video for instructions and it was really easy to do, the nails came out great. I even did a pink to white ombre.

I just wanted to give an honest review of these powders after using all colors. After using the product a deem them a great product. These powders are highly pigmented and are easy to use. When I run out I will be ordering more. Over all the covid-19 issues and chaos I was still able to see it my product in a timely fashion with no problems.

Scrolling through different acrylic products I didn’t believe the price so of course I had to get it and test it out myself. I loved all the colors and it was for the most part easy to use as well. Only down side would be that it dries up more on the quick side so you just have to work fast. Overall, great product for the price you pay!

So I was going to do my nails and realized I didn't have no clear, So I quickly ordered this set not knowing how it was going to look. The clear is actually really clear. The acrylic is fine enough for dip nails. And the colors are nice. I will be trying out the grey Soon.  Add this set to your collection

This was my first time ever using acrylic powder and it was very easy to use. You get a nice amount to use and could use it many times before you run out. The colors are amazing!! Especially the gray!!! I very much recommend this product even if it's not for a first time use. It is a wonderful product!

As a beginner learning to do my own nails because of the pandemic was a bit of a struggle, but after several YouTube videos I bought some monomer and acrylic powder and began to learn.  This product is amazing once you get use to with the brush, but it's also great for dipping!  Highly recommend it!

I wasn't sure if this was going to be a good brand or not, and it's not bad. I love that it comes with a Grey color, you do not see that color acrylic at all, and in sets like this, usually you just get the 3 main colors, pink, white and clear. So nice to be able to spice it up with a cool color

great colors! i think these are great if you know how to use acrylic powders!!! if you’re a beginner i’d recommended using a different one before trying these. just because practicing how to apply the acrylic can make a huge difference when it comes to colored powders vs clear! overall love 🙌🏼💕

claims.text: Many reviewers find the powder easy to use and beginner-friendly, especially for at-home use.
Reviewers commonly use it successfully as a dip powder rather than traditional acrylic.
Customers praise the color variety and pigment quality, including the four-color set.
Several reviewers note good value and generous product for the price, though some mention smaller-than-expected containers.
A few reviewers report issues with workability, such as the white being hard to manage or drying quickly.
